declarations.dependencies: Its own services cognitive-os-api, cognitive-os-web (+ -web-2, -web-3) and cognitive-db (Projects/internal/cognitive-engineering-os/docker-compose.yml, ops/cognitive-db/docker-compose.cognitive-db.yml), Anthropic for AI drafting (COGNITIVE_OS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; absent key -> /ai/* 503 AI_PROVIDER_UNCONFIGURED, main.py:663, :1562), and the AwareWave collect product for research collection (products.ts dependsOn ["collect"]; collection_service.py:60); collect's own services and env come from lib/collect/MODULE_MANIFEST.json through that dependsOn closure, not from this list. declarations.migration_rollback_contract: Alembic with raw-SQL migrations, explicit migration step in deploy and never automatic (STORAGE_SWITCH.md D2 :12; deploy/deploy.sh:9); 8 of the 8 versions define downgrade() (grep def downgrade in ai_lego/data/migrations/versions; 0001_baseline.py:319). deploy.sh rolls back the image and takes a pre-deploy dump through the cognitive-db backup script (deploy/lib-db.sh:77, deploy.sh:9). declarations.invariants: Only approved collection_sources rows become crawl seeds; a discovered candidate is data, not permission (lib/collect/sources-store.ts:6, approvedSeeds :228). Every outbound crawl request goes through ctx.fetch with the SSRF gate on each hop (lib/collect/net/fetcher.ts:226) and robots/politeness; provider calls go only to the fixed origins in lib/collect/net/providers.ts and the API key never reaches a block (providers.ts header). Every collected document is stamped EVIDENCE / SOURCE_QUOTATION, never SOURCE_FACT, and instruction-shaped text goes to a human queue instead of the store (lib/collect/provenance.ts header, orchestrator.ts:440). A run needs the collect.fetch grant (lib/collect/run.ts:118). Each run is capped at 200 fetches, 200 MB and 10 minutes (run.ts:78).
declarations.dependencies: supabase (tables above plus ops_incidents for alerts and cs_knowledge_sources through the kb sink), renderer (default rendered tier, RENDERER_URL / RENDERER_SHARED_SECRET, lib/collect/net/providers.ts:45-48), trigger (collect-research-run task; schedules-heartbeat drives run-due), external search/extract vendors chosen by configuration (Brave, Serper, Firecrawl; providers.ts:57-90), OpenAI embeddings when the kb sink stores documents (lib/kb/rag.ts:41). No other AwareWave product: products.ts dependsOn is empty; Cognitive OS depends on collect, not the reverse. Inventory: ADR 017 section 5 row collect.
declarations.failure_isolation_boundary: A candidate block that fails extraction degrades to the next candidate for the same URL and records an issue instead of stopping the run (lib/collect/orchestrator.ts header ordering, :529); budget exhaustion ends the run with a report, not an exception (lib/collect/budget.ts). Run state is persisted so a budget-limited crawl resumes instead of restarting (lib/collect/state.ts header). A manual run is not awaited by the HTTP request; losing the in-memory tracker on restart loses only the polling answer, not the crawl or its durable record (lib/collect/run-jobs.ts header). Deleting the kb sink leaves collection and the knowledge base both working (lib/collect/sinks/kb.ts header).
declarations.data_lifecycle: collection_runs keeps one row per run with its report (lib/collect/report-store.ts:84); collection_url_state keeps etag / last-modified / capped outbound links per URL so unchanged pages are not refetched (lib/collect/url-state.ts header); the fact-check mirror replaces whole generations and prunes the old one in short batches (migration 0095 comments :18-21, :135); the in-memory research progress map drops finished entries after a fixed age (lib/collect/research-progress.ts:27-32). Knowledge-base versions and deletion are the knowledge base's lifecycle, not collect's.
declarations.observability_contract: Every real run writes collection_runs and collection_issues (lib/collect/report-store.ts:84); trouble raises one ops_incidents row per tenant and failure shape with fingerprint collection:<org>:<shape>, so it reaches Telegram/Slack through the existing incident pipeline with its de-duplication (report-store.ts:147-170). The collect-research-run task logs its result and sends exceptions to Sentry (collect-research-run.ts). The operator page app/(shell)/ops/collect shows sources, refusal reasons and run results.
declarations.migration_rollback_contract: Migrations 0073, 0074, 0080, 0081, 0082, 0090 and 0095 each have a down script in lobster-factory/packages/db/scripts (<n>_down.sql, run by hand, not by the forward migration runner); 0073's deletes the collection incidents before restoring the ops_incidents source constraint (0073_collection_runs_and_issues_down.sql:1-6). 0095 also has a local verify script (scripts/0095_collect_claimreview_mirror-local-verify.sh). 0080 is optional at runtime: without a url-state store the crawler behaves as before the table existed (lib/collect/url-state.ts header).
declarations.replacement_strategy: Each source kind is one collector block and each destination one sink block, added or removed by one file that calls registerCollector / registerSink (lib/collect/registry.ts:9-25); a vendor is one entry in lib/collect/net/providers.ts plus a driver, selected by COLLECT_SEARCH_PROVIDER / COLLECT_EXTRACT_PROVIDER (lib/collect/search/drivers.ts:15, collectors/extract-provider.ts:40). No vendor name appears in business logic (providers.ts header).
